source.basis: Operator spec page; structured facts only, no operator prose reproduced.

reading.body:
CyrusOne's San Antonio SAT5-SAT6 campus publishes 33 MW of IT capacity, sixth among the 19 Texas data centers that disclose power figures, but that rank measures disclosure, not actual market position.

The campus's 33 MW across 175,000 square feet implies roughly 825 racks at 40 kW per rack, about 6,600 accelerator slots, but the operator does not state actual rack density or accelerator count. Its certifications, SOC 2 Type 2, PCI DSS, HIPAA, FISMA, TIA-942, and HITRUST, qualify it for regulated enterprise and healthcare workloads, not specialized AI infrastructure.

Texas has 133 mapped data center facilities, but only 19 publish capacity figures, so the campus's 6.9% share of the disclosed 475 MW is a visibility artifact. No published facts cover grid interconnection, power source, or whether the 33 MW is allocated or available, so this facility cannot be assessed as a binding constraint on AI scaling.
